Paste crash report content here

- OS: [e.g. Ubuntu 22.04]
- Desktop Environment: [e.g. GNOME, KDE Plasma]
- Session Type: [e.g. Wayland, X11]

- PyQt6 Version: [e.g. 6.4.2]
- Sound Server: [e.g. PulseAudio, PipeWire]
- Installation Format: [e.g. deb, snap, flatpak, AppImage]

Add any other context about the problem here.
